narration:0:1522112001:0.text: With nothing nearby demanding your attention, you wait in silence.
narration:0:1522112001:0.source_cn: 周围已没什么令你在意的人或事，因此你安静地等待着
narration:0:1522112001:0.male: With nothing nearby demanding your attention, you wait in silence.
narration:0:1522112001:0.female: With nothing nearby demanding your attention, you wait in silence.

narration:1:1522112002:0.text: After a while, Samu finally opens his eyes.
narration:1:1522112002:0.source_cn: 半晌之后，小赛穆终于睁开了眼睛
narration:1:1522112002:0.male: After a while, Samu finally opens his eyes.
narration:1:1522112002:0.female: After a while, Samu finally opens his eyes.

say:3:1522112003:0.text: He's awake... Samu! My baby, you're awake!
say:3:1522112003:0.source_cn: 醒了……小赛穆，我的孩子！你终于醒了！

say:4:1522112004:0.text: Oh thank goodness! Hurry, see if the child's okay!
say:4:1522112004:0.source_cn: 太好了，快看看孩子有没有事！

say:7:1522112006:0.text: Oh, sweetheart... Mommy will get you something. Just hold on...
say:7:1522112006:0.source_cn: 可怜的孩子……妈妈这就去给你找吃的……

say:8:1522112007:0.text: Don't trouble yourself. I've got half a ration of bread left. Let the boy have it.
say:8:1522112007:0.source_cn: 别折腾了。我能从配给能省下半块面包，拿给孩子吃吧。

say:9:1522112008:0.text: Thank you... thank you so much...

say:11:1522112009:1.text: Samu's safe, Mr. Bakis. I trust that's enough to convince you the Arcane Council means no harm.
say:11:1522112009:1.source_cn: 既然小赛穆无恙，学者，我想你会相信魔法师协会的善意。

say:12:1522112010:0.text: This is the remedy I promised. It'll help ease the symptoms, but it's not a cure. The curse runs deeper than any sickness, and only magic can fix it.
say:12:1522112010:0.source_cn: 这是我方才写好的药方，可以缓解相同的症状，但根治只能依...

say:13:1522112011:0.text: We won't be staying in the city. You won't always have us around. This should help your people hold out until more mages arrive.
say:13:1522112011:0.source_cn: 我们三人不会一直留在城内，不能随叫随到。依靠这份药方，...

say:14:1522112012:0.text: ... Alright. If I need you, I'll send word.

say:15:1522112013:1.text: For this poor child's sake, I'll put in a few good words. See if I can get Abundius to meet with you.
say:15:1522112013:1.source_cn: 看在这可怜孩子的份上，这一次我会替你们美言几句，让阿邦...

say:16:1522112014:0.text: Whether you can convince him, whether anything changes, that's up to you now.
say:16:1522112014:0.source_cn: 劝不劝得动他，能不能改变现状，这就要看你们的能耐了。

say:17:1522112015:0.text: But don't think I'm letting the corpse desecration slide! That debt still stands!
say:17:1522112015:0.source_cn: 当然，我的美言不包括你们亵渎尸体的事！这笔账我迟早会和...

say:19:1522112016:0.text: Mr. Bakis! How can you trust them? They sided with the Wildborn!
say:19:1522112016:0.source_cn: 比博学者，你怎么能这么轻易相信他们，他们可是在和兽人为...

say:22:1522112018:0.text: Keep a close eye on your Wildborn. She may be just a child, but not everyone in Halia will be so forgiving.
say:22:1522112018:0.source_cn: 看好你们身边的兽人。她还是个孩子，但难保呼临城内不会有...

say:23:1522112019:0.text: We understand. And thank you, for giving the Arcane Council a chance.
say:23:1522112019:0.source_cn: 你的好意我们感受到了。谢谢你愿意相信魔法师协会。
